# v2026.10.43

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.43.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.43.md).

This release covers **10 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Rules opens on cards (Drafts, Price codes, Invoices), each with its own page, and has its own icon in the sidebar. ([#227](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/227), [#229](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/229))
- Automations has its own Settings page in the sidebar. ([#229](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/229))
- A job's panel shows one short line per problem, and reviews a changed job in a sidecar. ([#230](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/230))
- Every page shows its title only, and every icon-only control names itself on hover. ([#218](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/218))
- Sentry events carry product and client tags for the shared support desk. ([#219](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/219))
- The Jobs list uses the same page width as every other page, and the search icon sits level with the tab names. ([#226](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/226), [#228](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/228))

## Changes

- Every page shows its title only, and every icon-only control names itself on hover. ([#218](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/218))
- Sentry events carry product and client tags for the shared support desk. ([#219](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/219))
- Rules opens on cards, one page per part, with its own icon; Automations has its own page. ([#227](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/227), [#229](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/229))
- A job's panel shows one short line per problem, and reviews a changed job in a sidecar. ([#230](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/230))

## Fixes

- The page search icon sits level with the tab names. ([#226](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/226))
- The Jobs list uses the same page width as every other page, and the default accent says Default. ([#228](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/228))
